findings.title: Polyline center calculation produces incorrect placement
findings.body: The fallback calculates the center by averaging polyline vertices. This is not the geometric or bounding-box center and is biased by uneven vertex spacing; closed CAD polylines may also repeat the first vertex, shifting the result toward that corner. Foundations extracted from ordinary closed outlines can therefore be placed at the wrong coordinates. Compute the outline bounds or a proper polygon centroid after handling any duplicated closing point.

findings.title: Polyline foundations always lose their rotation
findings.body: Every polyline-derived foundation is assigned RotationAngle = 0, regardless of the orientation of its CAD outline. Rotated rectangular foundations will consequently be created axis-aligned. Derive orientation from the outline, such as its principal or longest edge, and preserve that angle in FoundationData.

findings.title: CAD foundation dimensions are ignored
findings.body: All detected foundations are created from one arbitrary first FamilySymbol, while FoundationData.Length and Width are never populated or applied. CAD outlines of different sizes therefore produce identical foundation instances and cannot reproduce the source geometry. Extract the dimensions and select or parameterize an appropriate foundation type before placement.
